_about: The one source of the pipeline picture. scripts/gen-pipeline-blocks.mjs renders a block from this file into every backend group and frontend feature README (between <!-- pipeline:begin --> and <!-- pipeline:end -->); quality/check_docs.mjs fails when a block is missing or stale. Stages match project-docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_TIMELINE.md section 1b (two clocks: facts daily, readings weekly; decided 2026-10-21). Edit here, then run: node scripts/gen-pipeline-blocks.mjs

backend/pipeline.part: the selector (1), the story writer and forecasts (2), story analysis, country briefings, drift notes and the story web (3, daily notes kept as cited input)
backend/pipeline.timeline: writes no facts or readings; its raw rows are the source of entry, story_born and forecast_drawn facts, read only through world/

backend/situations.part: the map ingest and GDACS ingest (1), the map tracker (2)
backend/situations.timeline: writes no facts yet; future source of situation facts; the map becomes a view later

backend/predictions.part: the forecast watch, gather, judge and record (newsPredictionResolver), forecast settling and the track-record snapshot
backend/predictions.timeline: writes no facts; the resolver appends verdict lines to record/inbox/verdicts/ for newsStoryRecord, and PRED# rows are the source of forecast_drawn facts

backend/shared.part: world/, the only reader of the raw tables, plus the shared rules, the actor table and the S3 helpers
backend/shared.timeline: writes no facts or readings; every other stage reads raw tables only through world/

backend/record.part: newsStoryRecord appends the daily facts (5) and rebuilds the views (7); newsRecordReview writes the weekly readings (6)
backend/record.timeline: newsStoryRecord is the only writer of record/facts, record/runs (daily) and record/views; newsRecordReview is the only writer of record/readings and record/runs/review-*; views are rebuilt from both

backend/board.part: the board's Lambda (boards, follows, presets, connect)
backend/board.timeline: writes no facts or readings; reads the record views (story, links and counts; the settled past from readings, the unsettled present from daily counts), with world/ for what the views do not hold yet

backend/weekly.part: the analyst's weekly: schema, section model, pull, check, publish
backend/weekly.timeline: writes the weekly report (weekly/), a view of the week's readings; today only the content model exists, the pull, check and publish scripts are on unmerged branches

backend/read-api.part: the read proxy and the per-user endpoints that serve every page
backend/read-api.timeline: writes no facts or readings; serves raw tables and S3 JSON today; the board reads the record views directly, other pages move to views in plan step 4

backend/distribution.part: the weekly email, the old weekly brief, breaking alerts and social posts
backend/distribution.timeline: writes no facts or readings; consumers moving to the weekly report and the record views

backend/monitoring.part: model guard, freshness monitor, error digest, audits
backend/monitoring.timeline: writes no facts or readings; Run objects are the record's own signal and the operator does not want pipeline alarms (2026-10-31)

backend/membership-studio.part: billing (Polar) and the retired Studio Lambda
backend/membership-studio.timeline: writes no facts or readings; reads none

backend/economy-parked.timeline: parked; writes no facts or readings; reads none

features/home.timeline: reads today's topics from raw tables; target: the daily facts and counts

features/map.timeline: reads world/latest.json from the map pipeline; target: a map view of the facts

features/threads.part: the story page and the stories list
features/threads.timeline: rebuilds story history from raw tables; target: the story view (facts plus readings)

features/countries.timeline: reads country rows from raw tables; country views are not needed now

features/briefings.part: the daily and weekly briefs page
features/briefings.timeline: reads the briefs; target: daily facts and the weekly report

features/track-record.timeline: reads predictions/track_record.json; target: forecast and verdict facts

features/board.timeline: reads boards via newsBoard and the record views (stories, links, counts) through the Worker; reading fields fill as the weekly review runs

features/account.timeline: reads country history and prefs from raw tables; target: board and record views

features/breaking.timeline: reads breaking alerts; not a record view

features/static.timeline: reads the daily brief only; not a record view

features/analysis-studio.part: shared-run pages of the retired Studio
